findings.label: SW-first silent drop
findings.detail: schedule() returns { ok: true } as soon as the heula/schedule-reminder message is posted and does not fall back to the in-page timer if SW delivery fails (no controller and navigator.serviceWorker.ready rejects). Acceptable under the stated best-effort contract; a lost SW message is a silently lost reminder. Consider an in-page fallback arm when the post cannot be confirmed.

findings.label: Unwired start reminder
findings.detail: scheduleStartReminder is exported but never called; the startEnabled toggle persists a preference that arms no reminder. Pre-existing and intentionally kept to preserve the stable exported surface required by the task. Either wire it to a start-time schedule or signal in the UI that it is not yet active.

findings.label: Dead copy key
findings.detail: copy.settings.reminderUnsupported is now unused; the UI reads reminderUnsupportedHint, an identical string. Remove the stale key.
